morphology.pattern_note: 英语专名，通常写作 Frye，整词记忆；不按马来语词缀拆分。所列音标为英语读音，末尾 e 不单独发音。

senses.zh_definition: 弗赖：英语姓氏；在文学批评语境中可指加拿大文学批评家诺思罗普·弗赖。具体人物须依上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A surname, borne notably by the Canadian literary critic Northrop Frye; the intended bearer depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga, antaranya nama keluarga Northrop Frye, pengkritik sastera Kanada; orang yang dimaksudkan bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正式书写首字母大写；不能当作普通马来语词解释，也不能等同于英语 fry。输入没有提供具体人物，以下例句采用文学研究语境。马来文释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 引文；所列搭配是常见指称结构。[人物资料：多伦多大学维多利亚学院图书馆](https://library.vicu.utoronto.ca/exhibitions/nfrye100/biography.html)

dual_scenarios.en: This study examines Northrop Frye's contribution to literary criticism.

etymology.historical_story: Frye enters this entry as a surname, rather than an inherited Malay vocabulary item. One documented bearer, Northrop Frye, studied at Victoria College in Toronto and later joined its English department. His academic career explains the surname's appearance in literary discussion. The packet does not establish a particular bearer or the surname's deeper historical origin. [Source: Victoria University Library](https://library.vicu.utoronto.ca/exhibitions/nfrye100/biography.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Frye /fraɪ/ 连同全名 Northrop Frye 一起读，想象文学课书脊上的作者姓氏；记住末尾 e 不另读。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式文章首次提及人物时写全名 Northrop Frye，随后可用 Frye；不要自行添加未经确认的马来西亚荣衔。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于人物介绍、书目和学术讨论。姓氏本身不能确定具体人物，翻译时应先核对全名。
